title: Share of US centenarians who are men: today vs. 2054 (projected)

source.name: US centenarian population estimates and projections
source.publisher: Pew Research Center, based on U.S. Census Bureau data and projections

notes: As of 2024, 78% of US centenarians are women and 22% are men. The Census Bureau projects that by 2054, women will make up 68% of centenarians and men 32% -- the gender gap at the very top of the age distribution is projected to narrow.
